原: The first is release, unburdening yourself of frustration…
疑为: The first is release. Unburdening yourself of frustration…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译文分成两句。

原: …less likely to encounter what I did, that’s right.
疑为: …less likely to encounter what I did? —That’s right.
理由: 句末 that’s right 是女士的回应，被并进了男士的话；译文用破折号隔开。

原: You could, and don’t do the interview at all.
疑为: You could, and not do the interview at all.
理由: and don’t 语法不通，意思是“也可以干脆不参加面谈”；照此译。

原: At midday, we stayed in the hut.
疑为: At midday, we stayed in the hut and did nothing.
理由: 46、47 本是一句，在 and 前被句号切断；按一句的意思分两段译。

原: …without the use of specialized terms, they also felt less informed…
疑为: …without the use of specialized terms. They also felt less informed…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译文分成两句。

疑为: Hillary Shulman（第 92 句写作 Schulman）
理由: 同一人名前后拼法不一（Shulman / Schulman）；全文统一译作“希拉里·舒尔曼”。

原: …the benefits of vaccines, Schulman concedes that…
疑为: …the benefits of vaccines. Shulman concedes that…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句，人名拼法与第 85 句不一；译文分成两句。

原: …set the hill on fire, Patio Higgins, a disreputable local businessman, became convinced…
疑为: …set the hill on fire. Pattillo Higgins, a disreputable local businessman, became convinced…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；人名 Patio 是 Pattillo（帕蒂洛）的误写（第 114 句又作 Petilio）；译作“帕蒂洛·希金斯”。

原: …practically no industry, cotton and beef were the foundation of the economy.
疑为: …practically no industry; cotton and beef were the foundation of the economy.
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译文用逗号分句照常译。
缺所有格撇号；译作“希金斯的那口井”。
与第 100 句 Patio 拼法不一，实为 Pattillo；统一译作“帕蒂洛·希金斯”。

原: …followed by three or four questions, the recordings will be played only once.
疑为: …followed by three or four questions. The recordings will be played only once.
理由: 两句说明被逗号连成一句；译文分成两句。

疑为: they are a minority / in the minority

原: …which run for hundreds of kilometers from.
疑为: …which run for hundreds of kilometers from mines to their destinations.
理由: 156、157 本是一句，在 from 和 mines 之间被句号切断；按一句的意思分两段译（用省略号衔接）。

原: mines To their destinations, here when the truck arrives…
疑为: （mines to their destinations 属上句）Here, when the truck arrives…
理由: 同上；后半是另一句，被逗号连上；译文分开。

原: …to deploy, maintain, and improve it, the automation and digitization…
疑为: …to deploy, maintain, and improve it. The automation and digitization…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译文分成两句。

原: …at 1.24 million, according to the institute, the overall number…
疑为: …at 1.24 million. According to the institute, the overall number…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译文分成两句。

原: …more people than ever before, those countries have swelling young populations…
疑为: …more people than ever before. Those countries have swelling young populations…
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译文分成两句。
